scope: Five preregistered synthetic text generations; stage B stopped by rule. Unchanged product prompts, no ASR or product UI.

preregistered_contract.reason: The original approved plan says to compare 4B if 2B is insufficient; the preserved 2B screen triggered that condition.

stage_a.selection_reason: Cover the observed 2B date/option fabrication, task replacement, sound-check fabrication, live truncation, and checklist/risk-list correction confusion with the smallest five-request screen. Selection is deliberately enriched for failures, not a representative success rate.

stage_b.only_if: Every stage-A request ends without truncation, passes strict schema validation, and independent item review finds no material fidelity problem. Otherwise all three controls remain not_run_by_stop_rule.
stage_b.selection_reason: Only after stage A passes, complete the remaining original controls to check proposal/unknown preservation and the pre-correction assignment before considering a combined resource experiment.

preregistered_contract.resource_boundary: One isolated model process reuses weights within each stage and fresh prompt caches per request. Shared installed-app lock, idle and preservation checks. No concurrent ASR/LS-EEND, production provider or UI changes.
preregistered_contract.decision_boundary: A negative screen stops further summary generations and does not authorize a combined load test. If all eight pass materially, report the evidence and remaining uncertainty before deciding whether a minimal combined-resource test is justified.

generation.model_reuse: one loaded model for every request
